memory_candidates.content: When mechanically screening generated/drafted text for banned prefix words (e.g. RE-SCOPED, STANDING, HARD, CAPSTONE), a plain substring grep false-positives on ordinary words containing the token as a substring (e.g. 'HARD' inside 'hardcoded'). Use a word-boundary regex (grep -niE '\b(WORD1|WORD2)\b') instead of a bare substring match to avoid spurious screen failures.
